# Evidence card — Choose what's next

Organisation and problem-solving are promising components of clinician-delivered CBT. An AI prioritiser has not been tested.

Use only these claims, within the scope stated. None of them tested this software.

- **CLM-RS-CBT-COMPONENTS** (checked against an abstract or summary only): A component network meta-analysis of 43 trials and 3,817 participants (Matsumoto et al., 2024, BMJ Mental Health) found that CBT packages including organisational strategies were associated with higher treatment response, and problem-solving components with reduced inattention. These are associations from trial-level modelling of therapist-delivered CBT, possibly including adolescents, not evidence for this software.
  Source: [Components of cognitive-behavioural therapy for mitigating core symptoms in attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder: a systematic review and network meta-analysis](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjment-2024-301303).

Full register, statuses and limitations: `evidence/claims.yaml` in the source repository. Runtime snapshot: `references/shared/runtime-evidence.md`. No claim has been reviewed by a clinician.
